content: Remove active D0022 contradictions and exact failed-route artifacts left by the earlier Nix source-snapshot workflow, while preserving historical records and legitimate tool materializations.

Applied D0022 to the remaining active surfaces: NixOS packaging now requires an explicitly packaging-owned daemon package; test and PGO ownership returned to CTest, tests, performance evidence, and packaging; lifecycle evidence moved outside the repository; obsolete root build/result routes are visible to Git; future checkpoints describe engineering handoffs rather than source snapshots. Historical sessions and checkpoints were not rewritten.

Exact cleanup removed at least 2,749,767,680 bytes of project temporary files, pycache, old result roots, and empty route directories. A separately validated 1,294-path dead Nix referrer closure (SHA-256 ab9b8811e981483d61e18f93eabb54b0ca35f826e0943635705f01115f14ab07) deleted old source copies, product outputs, flake checks, packages, staging paths, and closure metadata; Nix reported 26.1 GiB freed. No broad GC ran. Final checks found zero matching old product seeds, source copies, project roots, or task-owned temporary paths, while 104 legitimate MetaFlux tool materializations remained.

Content revision 2eba873670473cfb002d66e1ff442674929afc06 passed Nix syntax and format checks, hook/Python syntax, Agent records and 54-case self-test, 68-case skill routing and 23-case self-test, flake output inspection, Clang 22.1.8, CMake 4.1.6, Ninja 1.13.2 probes, NixOS module positive/negative evaluation, stale-semantic scans, and independent diff review. No C++ build-affecting source changed.
